reserves.name: ZAR fiat reserves
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company (JHB) and Standard Bank of South Africa

sources.label: Kempen ZARP agreed-upon procedures report dated October 1, 2026, covering September 30 reserve balances

reserveReview.rationale: Kempen Audit's October 1, 2026 agreed-upon procedures report verifies September 30 bank balances of R89,485,830 at Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company JHB and R3,618,969 at Standard Bank. The attached management report states R93,104,798.40 of cash and equivalents against 77,605,468.69 circulating ZARP as at September 30, 2026 at 16:26. The bank components are printed in whole rand and total R93,104,799, R0.60 above the management total; the four whole-token chain figures total 77,605,469, 0.31 above management circulation. These display-precision differences are retained rather than replacing the reported totals. Kempen gives factual findings under ISRS 4400 (Revised), explicitly not an assurance opinion. The complete curated composition remains 100% ZAR fiat reserves; the report does not establish the custody or maturity of instruments beyond the named bank and trust accounts. The October 13 review downloaded and visually checked the current report linked by ZARP's official transparency page. The balance clock remains September 30, not the October 1 report date or the page's newer live counters.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Kempen Audit ISRS 4400 (Revised) agreed-upon procedures report on ZARP's September 30, 2026 reserve balances
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report verifies rand balances in the Old Mutual Wealth trust account and Standard Bank accounts, but does not provide a reserve-asset subcategory or establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation terms.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Kempen verified the Old Mutual Wealth trust account and ZARP Standard Bank accounts, while management states that reserve funds are free of other debts, liens, and encumbrances and reserved exclusively for redemption. The materials do not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or a redemption settlement time.
